notes.title: Industry Giant returns to the big stage!
notes.content:
Greetings, Industry Giant!

Friends of the cult classic can rejoice: Industry Giant has awakened again and is returning in a new guise!

Industry Giant 4.0 presents itself during the Steam Next Fest! The demo version is already available today for eager industrial tycoons! So don't hesitate and get the demo now!

The reinterpretation of the cult classics is looking forward to seeing old fans again and inspiring a new generation of players!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2913720/Industrie_Gigant_40_Demo/

[url=https://discord.gg/toplitz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796060/a4789b012112267f938a48d51beeffb92c9b28d0.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale has started!
notes.content:
Hello dear giant!

Summer will be over before you know it, honestly! Be prepared for autumn!

That's why we recommend taking precautions with games in the medium and long term! So it's handy that the big Steam Summer Sale starts today and you can expect numerous bargains! Stock up on games!

The giants are reasonably priced this time, but we also want to focus your attention on the upcoming Industry Giant 4.0, which will challenge you leaders of industry in the coming future. 

Therefore, use the power of the Wishlist and put the Industry Giant 4.0 on it and get Industry Giant 2 DIRECTLY at the STEAM SUMMER SALE!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/271360/Industry_Giant_2/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129570/Industrie_Gigant_40/

notes.title: Industry Giant 4.0 - Where giants roam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9784945/f4b22aa2ac0ada4931cedd2cbc8ce719429211eb.png[/img]

Greetings, masters of industry!

The years have passed, the beards have grown longer, but the power is unbroken! And to keep it that way, the Industry Giant is coming back in version 4.0!

Fire up the machines, hire staff, ramp up the production lines, because things are set in motion in a not-so-distant future!

[previewyoutube=x62H0jte0wU;full][/previewyoutube]

Industry Giant 4.0 is waiting for you here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129570/Industry_Giant_40/
